title: Shocking Catchy Title #Shorts
topic: Dark Psychology: Manipulation tactics people secretly use in conversations
script: You think you know yourself better than anyone else, but what if the truth is, you're being manipulated? Behind the scenes of every conversation, there's a game of psychological cat and mouse. People use manipulation tactics to get what they want, often without even realizing it. They use mirroring, gaslighting, and emotional blackmail to control the narrative. But what if you're not the victim, but the puppet master? Are you being manipulated, or are you the one doing the manipulating? Ask yourself, are you trapped in a never-ending loop of self-deception?
